scope: R13/AC1012 from-scratch DWG generated by LibreDWG dwgadd; hash-bound legacy HEADERS section and inner HEADER envelope accounting. The generated file remains in /private/tmp and is not a repository fixture.

authority.document: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
rules: R13 section locators identify the HEADERS section span.
The decoded HEADER envelope contains a begin sentinel, declared data size, CRC, and end sentinel; account for every byte within the locator-declared section.

source.provenance: Created from scratch for this audit using LibreDWG dwgadd 0.14; not copied from a third party. Scratch files remain outside the repository.

decodedHeaderEnvelope.crcDisposition: Matching stored/calculated values are printed by the libdxfrw reader; this is not an independent CRC implementation.

implementationObservation.observation: The AC1012 reader parsed the complete HEADER envelope with zero unclaimed bytes, then failed at TABLES with BAD_READ_TABLES because a VPORT_CONTROL handle role was code 12 targeting handle 0x08. Frame coverage was unresolved (29/29); this receipt proves HEADER accounting only and identifies a separate version-specific parser issue.

limitations: The generated sample has one minimal line and does not represent a producer-authored drawing or broad AC1012 interoperability.
The VPORT_CONTROL failure is not resolved by this receipt; it requires exact field-role verification and bounded positive/negative controls before parser behavior changes.
No output or support claim is promoted.
